title: The Pale Signal
author: Ansel Vasquez
blurb: Sable Marchetti, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
